CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
Private Sub btnActualizar_Click()
If MsgBox("¿ESTA SEGURO DE ELIMINAR EL REGISTRO?", vbOKCancel + vbInformation, "Aviso") = vbOK Then
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM cosecha WHERE id =  " & Me.txtIdSiembra & "", dbFailOnError
    End If
    Me.cosechas.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub btnGuardar_Click()

If Not IsNull(Me.txtId) And Not IsNull(Me.txtFecha) And Not IsNull(Me.txtCantidad) And Not IsNull(Me.txtPeso) Then
         Select Case Me.OpenArgs
            Case 1
            
                CurrentDb.Execute "INSERT INTO cosecha(codigosistema,fechaCosecha,peso,pesoPromedio,numeroPlantasCosechadas,remision,factura,observacion)VALUES('" _
                & Me.txtId & "','" & Me.txtFecha & "','" & Me.txtPeso & "','" & Me.txtPPromedio & "','" & Me.txtCantidad & "','" & Me.txtRemision & "','" & Me.txtfactura & "'," _
                & Me.txtDescripcion & ")", dbFailOnError
                MsgBox "DATOS GUARDADOS", vbInformation, "Avíso"
                Forms!Frm_Siembra!SubFrm_Siembra.Form.Requery
                DoCmd.Close acForm, "Frm_DatosCosecha"
           Case 2
                CurrentDb.Execute "UPDATE cosecha SET fechaCosecha = '" & Me.txtFecha & "' WHERE id =  " & Me.txtIdSiembra & "", dbFailOnError
                MsgBox "DATOS MODIFICADOS", vbInformation, "Avíso"
                Forms!Frm_Siembra!SubFrm_Siembra.Form.Requery
                DoCmd.Close acForm, "Frm_DatosCosecha"
       End Select
    Else
        MsgBox "ES NECESARIO LLENAR TODOS LOS CAMPOS" & vbLf & vbLf & "Verifique.", vbInformation, "Avíso"
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub cosechas_Click()
Call recuperaRegistro2
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    If Me.OpenArgs = 1 Then
        Me.EtqTituloE_A.Caption = "Agregar cosecha"
    ElseIf Me.OpenArgs = 2 Then
        Me.EtqTituloE_A.Caption = "Modificar cosecha"
    Else
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub




Private Sub recuperaRegistro2()
    Dim rst As DAO.Recordset, SQL As String
    
    On Error GoTo ManipulaError
    SQL = "SELECT * FROM cosecha WHERE Id = " & Me.cosechas & ""
    Set rst = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(SQL, dbOpenForwardOnly)
    With rst
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtId] = !codigoSistema
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtIdSiembra] = !id
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtFecha] = !fechaCosecha
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtPeso] = !peso
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtPPromedio] = !pesoPromedio
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtCantidad] = !numeroPlantasCosechadas
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtRemision] = !remision
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtfactura] = !factura
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtfactura] = !factura
    End With
    rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    
Salir:
    Exit Sub
    
ManipulaError:
    If Not rst Is Nothing Then rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, "Atencion"
    Resume Salir
End Sub
